summary: Verified closing_resume WhatsApp notification now embeds PUBLIC /track/{token} link (replacing the old login-protected /crm/ticket/{id}/history). Created 7 focused pytest cases hitting the deployed REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All 7/7 passed: (a) admin auth + /auth/me, (b) notification_settings persist main_group=120363408836731773@g.us + send_closing_resume=true + default_group=120363430088957368@g.us, (c) full ticket lifecycle create -> process -> resolve returned 200/SELESAI, (d) closing_resume log row created with channel=internal, target=main_group, template_key=closing_resume_main, message contains 'RESUME PENYELESAIAN TICKET' + ticket number, (e) message contains /track/<token> AND does NOT contain /crm/ticket/, (f) public GET /api/track/{token} without auth returns 200 with ticket_number, status_label, non-empty timeline, non-null completion, (g) standard lifecycle notifications (created/assigned/resolved) still fire to default_group. Cleanup executed: reset settings to safe defaults (enabled=false, send_closing_resume=false, api_token=''). Note: hard-delete of created test tickets did not succeed (no delete endpoint exposed) - test tickets remain but are marked TEST_ClosingPublic_* customer_name.

minor.issue: No delete endpoint present; test tickets prefixed TEST_ClosingPublic_* were not deletable by admin (attempted both /tickets/{id} and /tickets/{id}/delete). Low priority — cleanup left them in SELESAI state.

critical_code_review_comments: notifications.py notify_closing_resume() correctly calls ensure_tracking_token() and builds `{base}/track/{token}` (line 741) — public path verified live.

ensure_tracking_token is idempotent (reuses existing token on the ticket) — the same token from the WhatsApp message resolved via GET /api/track/{token} without auth returned the full timeline + completion, matching spec.
Standard lifecycle events (created/assigned/resolved) still fire via notify_ticket_event on default_group — regression preserved.

notify_closing_resume is wrapped in try/except so a provider failure never rolls back the ticket close — good defensive design; verified ticket status persists SELESAI even when Fonnte token is a dummy (log status observed = sent/skipped/failed).
Public /api/track/{token} endpoint correctly excludes auth and does not leak MongoDB _id — response schema clean.
